reason: Nationalmuseum Sweden has an OPEN, no-auth JSON API on its own infra (api.nationalmuseum.se/api/objects, page/limit pagination, 208,334 objects total) plus a museum-own IIIF image host (nationalmuseumse.iiifhosting.com, referenced in collection.nationalmuseum.se CSP). The catalogue is overwhelmingly applied-art/ceramics (3D, OUT), but it ALSO holds large FLAT in-scope holdings perfect for the design genre: design/architecture/ornament drawings (Frihandsteckningar, Arkitekturritningar, Ornamentstick, Ritningar för industridesign/teaterscenografi/tillämpad konst, Studier, Skisser, Illustrationer — all under the (Teckningar/Ritningar) parent group) and prints (Grafik, Originalgrafik). Scope is cleanly separable because category.en encodes the parent group in parentheses: (Teckningar…/Ritningar…)=drawing IN, (Grafik)=print IN, (Måleri)=painting IN, (Fotografier…)=photograph IN, while (Konsthtv, konstind, ind.design)=3D object OUT and (Skulptur)=OUT. This isolates flat DESIGN DRAWINGS from photographed 3D products. IIIF images verified downloadable at ~1000px on the long edge (well above the 600px floor) — e.g. design drawings, architecture drawings, studies all returned real 685–1000px images. Random-spread sampling across the full id range (3000 items) found in-scope flat works with images extrapolating to ~9,000–13,000 drawings + ~2,500–3,500 prints + ~3,000 paintings. Probe: 15/15 in-scope works collected end-to-end with live R2 webp uploads, real metadata (artist/year/title/dimensions all present), 0 errors.
easy_source_found: YES — Nationalmuseum's own open API (no key). LIST: GET https://api.nationalmuseum.se/api/objects?page=P&limit=100 (max limit 100; response data.paging.total=208334, total_pages=2084; data.items[] each carry FULL metadata incl. id, inventory_number, iiif base URL, iiif_license, title{sv,en}, technique_material, category{sv,en}='Leaf (PARENT)', object_type, dimensions[], dating[]{date{en}, date_earliest, date_latest}, actors[]{actor_full_name, given/surname}). OBJECT: GET https://api.nationalmuseum.se/api/objects/{id}. IMAGE: museum-own IIIF (IIPImage level1) at {object.iiif}full/full/0/default.jpg → ~1000px long-edge JPEG (server caps output at 1000px even though info.json reports larger; size-by-width syntax returns HTTP 501, so use full/full). Documented (no official docs page) at byabbe.se/2020/02/18/the-nationalmuseum-api. NO aggregator used — both API host and IIIF host are the museum's own infra.
probe_summary: node scripts/scrape-nationalmuseum-se.mjs --probe → 15/15 in-scope works collected with LIVE R2 webp uploads (verified HTTP 200 image/webp, e.g. 1000x739 155KB real image). All min-4 fields present (year 15/15, dimensions 15/15, medium 14/15, objectNumber 13/15); ids prefixed 'nationalmuseum-se-'; imageUrl all R2; category enum clean (print+painting). Real artists/dates parsed: Anders Zorn 1909, John Singer Sargent 1918 WWI series, Albert Edelfelt 1884, Hubert Robert 1786, Willem Swidde 1691. classify dry-run confirmed source: 208,334 objects, 2,084 pages; API not id-sorted but grouped by collection (a contiguous ceramics block spans pages ~450–800, drawings cluster later) — full crawl scans all pages, the priority sort surfaces design drawings/prints first.

exhibitions_entry.name: Nationalmuseum
exhibitions_entry.description: Sweden's national museum of art and design, founded in 1792 and housed in an 1866 palace on the Blasieholmen peninsula in central Stockholm. Its ~700,000-object collection spans painting and sculpture alongside one of the world's great holdings of drawings (around half a million sheets) and a deep applied-art and design collection. A free, open API and an IIIF image server make its design, architecture and ornament drawings, prints and paintings publicly accessible.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 스톡홀름 도심 블라시에홀멘 반도에 자리한 스웨덴 국립미술관으로, 1792년에 세워져 1866년 완공된 궁전식 건물을 쓴다. 약 70만 점의 소장품은 회화와 조각은 물론, 약 50만 장에 이르는 세계적인 드로잉 컬렉션과 방대한 응용미술·디자인 소장품을 아우른다. 공개 API와 IIIF 이미지 서버를 통해 디자인·건축·장식 도안과 판화, 회화를 누구나 열어볼 수 있다.

notes: DESIGN-GENRE FIT: this is primarily a fine-art + decorative-arts national museum, but the FLAT design holdings (design/architecture/industrial-design/theatre-scenography/applied-art drawings + ornament & original prints) are large and cleanly machine-extractable, which is exactly the gap the 디자인 genre needs. SCOPE RULE (key insight): category.en is 'Leaf (PARENT)' and the PARENT in parentheses is the reliable scope signal — (Teckningar/Ritningar/Frihandsteckningar)=drawing, (Grafik)=print, (Måleri)=painting, (Fotografier)=photograph are IN; (Konsthtv, konstind, ind.design)=3D applied-art OBJECT and (Skulptur) are OUT. This correctly separates flat design DRAWINGS (in) from photographed 3D design PRODUCTS like 'Industridesign (Konsthtv…)'='tray with jars' (out). WATCH-OUTS handled in script: (a) records flagged for deletion have titles 'RADERAS'/'raderas /fel'/'makuleras' — filtered (rare, ~0% in sample, but 2 appeared in the lowest-id probe slice); (b) reproductive prints (Reproduktionsgrafik leaf) colour-gated via colorfulness()<20; drawings never colour-gated; original/ornament prints kept; (c) portrait miniatures (Miniatyrer leaf) excluded per guide §1; (d) IIPImage caps output at ~1000px and rejects size-by-width (HTTP 501) — script uses full/full and verifies ≥600px. FULL RUN: --full crawls all 2084 pages (~8 min), requires named+dated (min-4), prioritizes design (drawing→print→photo→painting), writes COMPACT JSON, hard-caps at 23MB; resumable via scripts/.state/nationalmuseum-se-progress.json, failures→nationalmuseum-se-failed.ndjson. classify dry-run (background) was still completing at handoff (slow due to 120ms/page courtesy sleep over 2084 pages); estimated_inscope/est_full_count ~13,500 is from random-spread sampling (3000 items × ~69 scale: drawings ~9–11k, prints ~2.5–3.5k, paintings ~3k, photos small) and the partial crawl (8,441 candidates by page 450 before the ceramics block). Probe JSON at public/data/nationalmuseum-se-collection-probe.json. NOT registered in exhibitions.js (per gap2 workflow, registration happens at full-scrape time). DO NOT-run-full respected.
